`crt_platform_v1.json` contains actual `PlatformExporter.manifest()` and `.context()`
output generated by `tools/stage_m_cross_repo_check.py` from a temporary CRT project.
It is synthetic test evidence: two CAN frames (not embedded), one original file
reference and a selected statistics artifact. It contains no production data.

The fixture retains real CRT IDs, nested provenance and hashes without manual
reshaping. Its static copy makes CI and the Stage M smoke independent of a CRT
checkout. The Stage M development report records producer file hashes and the
cross-repository compatibility check. To regenerate locally, run the optional
script with `--write-fixture`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`, AI-server's `src` on
PYTHONPATH, and the existing test loop workaround if needed. Regeneration changes
the UUIDs/timestamps and therefore the fixture hash.
